answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 5824 Country: Pakistan Title: If someone in pray complete his pray and after he remember that i have leave my one part of the pray.than u can do sijda saho or not. reply me pls. Question: If someone in pray complete his pray and after he remember that i have leave my one part of the pray.than u can do sijda saho or not. reply me pls. Answer ID: 5824 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 392/392=M/1429) If someone recalls after completion of his salah that he left a rukn (obligatory part) of the salah then he has to perform the salah again; it is not sufficient to do sajda sahv. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
